groups.name: nextramice.bff
groups.description: Backend-for-frontend security and browser session settings.

properties.name: nextramice.bff.base-path
properties.description: Base path for browser authentication endpoints.

properties.name: nextramice.bff.post-login-redirect
properties.description: Validated local path used after OAuth login.

properties.name: nextramice.bff.post-logout-redirect
properties.description: Validated local path used after provider logout.

properties.name: nextramice.bff.provider-logout
properties.description: Use OIDC RP-initiated logout when supported by the configured provider.

properties.name: nextramice.bff.refresh-skew
properties.description: Refresh an authorized client this long before token expiry.

properties.name: nextramice.bff.allowed-origins
properties.description: Exact HTTPS origins allowed to make credentialed BFF requests.

properties.name: nextramice.bff.exposed-claims
properties.description: Claim names allowed in the browser-visible session response.

properties.name: nextramice.bff.session.idle-timeout
properties.description: Maximum inactivity period for a browser session.

properties.name: nextramice.bff.session.absolute-timeout
properties.description: Maximum browser session age regardless of activity.
